changeSet.sql: UPDATE agent_action SET state = CASE WHEN write_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'UNCERTAIN' ELSE 'CANCELLED' END, stop_reason = CASE WHEN write_started_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'LEASE_LOST_AFTER_WRITE' ELSE 'WITHDRAWN' END, payload = NULL, leased_until = NULL, ended_at = clock_timestamp(), updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE kind = 'EMAIL' AND state IN ('PROPOSED', 'ADMITTED', 'EXECUTING') AND payload ->> 'kind' = 'ACCOUNT_SECURITY_CHANGED' AND payload #>> '{event,kind}' = 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED'; DELETE FROM event_publication WHERE event_type = 'de.tum.cit.aet.hephaestus.core.event.AccountSecurityChangedEvent' AND serialized_event::jsonb ->> 'kind' = 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED';
